subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for multi-agent completion isolation and fallback ownership?
rationale: The remaining failures are real, but the durable fix spans session ownership, subagent completion guarantees, fallback-lane cancellation, and optional completion-isolation semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only when linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Completion Isolation Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and map the remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause, link the production evidence to each owner, and close this umbrella only after every remaining symptom has a tracked home.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only when linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a product/architecture boundary decision across config, agent runtime, subagent delivery, and Gateway fallback behavior, and steipete has the strongest combined history across those paths.
